packageRules.description: Framework majors land together or not at all — Laravel, Livewire and the module package are upgraded as one deliberate piece of work, never as a drive-by.
PHP itself is pinned to the bundled runtime; a bump is a platform decision, not a dependency update.

Container images are pinned by digest so a tag cannot be moved under us; Renovate owns keeping the digest current. Scoped to dockerfile: the beatrax-app/spec workflows are referenced by a moving @v1 on purpose (OPS-R27) and must not be pinned.
